title: General Health Questionnaire, 12-item
description: 12 items about recent general health, each with its own four options; Likert scoring 0–3.

citation.text: Goldberg DP, Williams P (1988). A User's Guide to the General Health Questionnaire. Windsor: NFER-Nelson.

scoring.text: Likert scoring: sum of the 12 items (0–36). The GHQ method (options 0-0-1-1, total 0–12) can be added as a further computed variable. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Enter each item's four options in score order (0 first).
